title: Integrability of a Rademacher summand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. On the uniform probability space of sign vectors $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the random variable $x\mapsto a_i x_i$ belongs to $L^p$ for every exponent $p\in[0,\infty]$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is any real coefficient vector of length $n$
$i$ is any coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$p$ is any extended nonnegative real exponent
the underlying measure is uniform on the sign cube
